//: OFF-FLEET native coarse-ocean candidate. Build every z8 address with observed water records retained, then run native reduce_parent through z0. This config is not evidence that a global build or publication exists. Native/source/parity rehearsal and measured disk admission are required before the full cut.

publication_policy.static_directory_basis: Admission ceiling, not a completed global measurement: retained Liguria measured 7,616 DTT bytes/tile and 450,180,397 static bytes / 35,149,748 DTT bytes (12.8075x). Applying the observed average to 174,762 z0-z8 addresses estimates 1.24 GiB DTT and 15.88 GiB static. The bounded 4 GiB store / 48 GiB static ceilings allow headroom but MUST be confirmed against the new native parent/coastal rehearsal before a global job. Cache is separately capped at 32 GiB; source leaves and derived output coexist and must be included in free-disk admission.

url_policy.object_identity: the exact HTTPS URL and response SHA-256 in source-manifest.ndjson are immutable source identity; URL templates alone are never treated as content identity

request.retryable: network failures and HTTP 408, 425, 429, and 5xx only; exponential backoff without jitter

no_data.non_water: a non-404 failure, partial coverage, or no-data over non-water fails the cut; it is never synthesized

source_policy.ocean_policy: Native observed all-water records are retained for every leaf address; an absent child is never a water classification.

cache.eviction: shared on-disk leased LRU; every active shard shares this <=32 GiB bound

source_policy.config_digest_contract: SHA-256 over canonical JSON bytes of this complete run config; run-report.json and global-merge-report.json bind the observed source manifest to that digest

flow_config.source_license: Licence for Copernicus DEM instance COP-DEM-GLO-30-F
flow_config.source_coverage_policy: HTTP 200 is sampled source. HTTP 404 is an immutable no-coverage observation, recorded in the shared generation cache and interpreted as ocean only where the paired water classification is all-water. Other HTTP failures are retried by the bounded runner and then fail the cut; partial/non-water no-data is never filled as land or water.
flow_config.ocean_policy: Retain native observed UNIFORM_WATER records; derive z0-z7 only from complete four-record sibling sets. No unmeasured shallow ancestor placeholders may be published.
